title: Aspen Search hero tile wall
description: A Swiss wall of square tiles split by 1px ink lines: a giant two-word name spread over a white tile and a grey tile, halftone media windows, an ink tile with a shouted all-caps headline, an ink intro tile with a mono button and a mint statement tile with a looping marquee of names. Desktop rows are half a window tall. The first word rises in on load; headline lines and copy rise line by line out of clips as they scroll into view.
notes: three media windows (mediaTop, mediaSide, mediaBottom); empty they're fixed halftone dot placeholders
rows are window-sized on desktop (half of 100svh minus the 61px header, at least 20rem)
giant words are sized in vw: about 5 and 6 letters fit the phone tiles
CSS only: load rise, marquee loop and view-timeline reveals are all off under reduced motion
